# FIT5145 Assignment 1 & 3: Data-Driven Pacing Corridor for HYROX Athletes

## Dataset Source

In this demonstration, the datasets are obtained by websracping and saved into csv files named:

- hyrox_season8_male_pro.csv

These datasets has been published to excelyynxl-a11 GitHub repository (link: <https://github.com/excelyynxl-a11y/fit5145/tree/main/ass1_3>). You can download the csv files and saved them into a data folder to carry out this demonstration.

## Load library

```{R}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(hms)
```

## Load dataset

```{R}
szn8_male_pro <- read_csv("data/hyrox_season8_male_pro.csv")
glimpse(szn8_male_pro)
```

## Data cleaning

### Inspect szn8_male_pro

Convert all time split into \<time\> format

```{R}
# Define all split columns
run_cols <- paste0("Running_", 1:8)
station_cols <- c(
  "SkiErg_1000m", 
  "Sled_Push_50m", 
  "Sled_Pull_50m",
  "Burpee_Broad_Jump_80m", 
  "Row_1000m", 
  "Farmers_Carry_200m",
  "Sandbag_Lunges_100m", 
  "Wall_Balls"
)
all_time_cols <- c("Total_Time", "Roxzone_Time", run_cols, station_cols)

```

```{R}
# Standardize all time columns to strict <time> (hms class)
time_fomatted_male <- szn8_male_pro %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(all_time_cols),
      ~ if (inherits(.x, "hms") || inherits(.x, "difftime")) {
          hms::as_hms(as.numeric(.x))
        } else {
          hms::as_hms(period_to_seconds(lubridate::hms(as.character(.x))))
        }
    )
  )

# Verify that all time split are of <time>
glimpse(time_fomatted_male)
```

Check for any NA values

```{R}
time_fomatted_male %>% filter(if_any(everything(), is.na))
```

We observed 784 rows contain NA values. Since only a small fraction (784 out of 12500 rows) of cases have several missings, we will drop these cases.

Check distinct City.

```{R}
time_fomatted_male %>% group_by(City) %>% summarise(count = n())
```

We observe the oddness that all City are recorded as "N/A" as characters instead of true NA values. Since City is totally missing for all entries and does not carry significance to the analysis, we will drop the City variable.

Check distinct Division.

```{R}
time_fomatted_male %>% group_by(Division) %>% summarise(count = n())
```

We observe that all athletes are HYROX PRO Division (ignore NA since it will be dropped later), which is correct based on our project scope. For easy gender reference, we will add a "MALE" remark – "MALE HYROX PRO".

Based on all inspection made, we will now clean szn8_male_pro and saved into a new male_pro_clean.

```{R}
male_pro_clean <- time_fomatted_male %>%
  # drop all NA cases
  filter(!if_any(everything(), is.na)) %>%
  # deselect City and athlete_url column
  select(- City, - athlete_url) %>%
  # remark MALE in Division
  mutate(
    Division = "MALE HYROX PRO"
  )
  

male_pro_clean %>% head()
```

## Descriptive Analysis

### 1. Running trajectory and slowdown

```{R}
male_long <- male_pro_clean %>%
  select(
    Division,
    starts_with("Running_")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Running_"),
    names_to = "Run_Name",
    values_to = "Run_Time"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Run_Num = as.numeric(str_extract(Run_Name, "\\d+")),
    Time_Sec = as.numeric(Run_Time)
  )

male_long
```

Generate summary of running Q1, Q2 or median, Q3

```{R}
run_summary <- male_long %>%
  group_by(Run_Num) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1_Sec    = quantile(Time_Sec, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Sec = median(Time_Sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3_Sec    = quantile(Time_Sec, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Coef_Variation = sd(Time_Sec) / mean(Time_Sec), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
run_summary %>% arrange(Run_Num)
```

Vizualize median run split time with interquartile range against run station.

```{R}
ggplot(run_summary, aes(x = Run_Num, y = Median_Sec)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q1_Sec, ymax = Q3_Sec), alpha = 0.25, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  # Vertical dashed line after Station 4 / Run 4
  geom_vline(xintercept = 4.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:8, labels = paste("Run", 1:8)) +
  labs(
    title = "HYROX Male Run-Time Trajectory",
    subtitle = "Median run split times with Interquartile Range; Dashed line marks Mid Race",
    x = "Run Segment",
    y = "Split Time (seconds)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

### Run slowdown rate distribution

```{R}
analysis_data <- male_pro_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Early_Run_Mean = rowMeans(across(all_of(run_cols[1:4]), as.numeric), na.rm = TRUE),
    Later_Run_Mean = rowMeans(across(all_of(run_cols[4:8]), as.numeric), na.rm = TRUE),
    Slowdown_Percentage = 100 * (Later_Run_Mean - Early_Run_Mean) / Early_Run_Mean,
    Pacing_Cat = case_when(
      Slowdown_Percentage > 10 ~ "Severe Fatigue (>10%)",
      Slowdown_Percentage > 0  ~ "Moderate Slowdown (0–10%)",
      TRUE              ~ "Negative Split (Faster Late)"
    ),
    Pacing_Cat = factor(Pacing_Cat, levels = c(
      "Negative Split (Faster Late)",
      "Moderate Slowdown (0–10%)",
      "Severe Fatigue (>10%)"
    ))
  )

analysis_data
```

Generate Q1, median and Q3 slowdown percentage summary.

```{R}
slowdown_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(), 
    Q1_Percentage = as.numeric(quantile(Slowdown_Percentage, 0.25)),
    Median_Percentage = median(Slowdown_Percentage),
    Q3_Percentage = as.numeric(quantile(Slowdown_Percentage, 0.75)),
    Percentage_Slower = 100 * mean(Slowdown_Percentage > 0)
  )
```

Vizualize distribution of run slowdown rate.

```{R}
# Extract key numbers for text display
Median_Value <- round(slowdown_summary$Median_Percentage, 1)
Percentage_Slow <- round(slowdown_summary$Percentage_Slower, 1)

ggplot(analysis_data, aes(x = Slowdown_Percentage, fill = Pacing_Cat)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Negative Split (Faster Late)" = "#10b981", # Green
      "Moderate Slowdown (0–10%)"    = "#3b82f6", # Blue
      "Severe Fatigue (>10%)"        = "#ef4444"  # Red
    )
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#b45309", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = slowdown_summary$Median_Percentage, linetype = "solid", color = "#1e3a8a", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate(
    "label", 
    x = slowdown_summary$Median_Percentage + 2, 
    y = Inf, 
    vjust = 1.3, 
    hjust = 0,
    label = paste0("Median: +", Median_Value, "%\nSlower: ", Percentage_Slow, "%"),
    fill = "white", 
    color = "#1e3a8a", 
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3, 
    label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"), 
    label.r = unit(0.1, "lines"),        
    label.size = 0.2                     
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hyrox Male Late-Race Run Slowdown Distribution",
    subtitle = "Slowdown = 100 × (Runs 5–8 Mean − Runs 1–4 Mean) / Runs 1–4 Mean",
    x = "Slowdown (%)",
    y = "Number of Male Athletes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

### Individual functional station time distribution

```{R}
male_station_long <- male_pro_clean %>%
  select(all_of(station_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Station",
    values_to = "Station_Time"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Station = factor(
      Station, 
      levels = station_cols,
      labels = c("SkiErg", "Sled Push", "Sled Pull","Burpee Broad Jumps", "Row", "Farmers Carry", "Sandbag Lunges", "Wall Balls")),
    Station_Sec = as.numeric(Station_Time)
  )

male_station_long %>% arrange(Station)
```

Generate summary for functional stations.

```{R}
station_summary <- male_station_long %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Q1_Sec = as.numeric(quantile(Station_Sec, 0.25)),
    Median_Sec = median(Station_Sec),
    Q3_Sec = as.numeric(quantile(Station_Sec, 0.75)),
    Coef_Variation = sd(Station_Sec) / mean(Station_Sec), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

station_summary
```

Visualize time split boxplots against each functional station.

```{R}
ggplot(male_station_long, aes(x = Station, y = Station_Sec)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#3b82a6", outlier.shape = NA) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, as.numeric(quantile(male_station_long$Station_Sec, 0.99)))) +
  labs(
    title = "Split time boxplot for each station",
    x = "Station", 
    y = "Split time (seconds)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
